verdict.rationale: Deep crawling is a fair question for a browser-automation and web-data platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers single-URL fetch, web search, and concurrent browser sessions. Nothing documents a crawl feature with a breadth-first strategy or a configurable maximum page limit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit
